=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:151 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `phase_labels` exclusion list omits mutually exclusive AI phase labels that are defined and used elsewhere, so they will not be removed during phase transitions.
  WHY: This breaks the at-most-one-phase-label invariant and can leave multiple AI phase labels on the same issue; reviewers agreed on the same root cause, with one reviewer also noting additional non-exclusive orchestrator labels outside the exclusion set.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:249 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The fallback `pr_data="$(gh api ...)"` call is not wrapped with `gh_retry`.
  WHY: A transient GitHub API failure on this fallback path can silently prevent linked-issue detection and leave issues in the wrong phase; one reviewer noted similar pre-existing calls elsewhere, but the consensus finding is about this new fallback line.
- tests/test_phase_label_transition_and_fallback_contract.py:60 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The test hardcodes the exact non-`gh_retry` `pr_data` fallback command string.
  WHY: If the workflow is fixed to use `gh_retry`, this assertion will fail and block CI until the test is updated; reviewers agreed this pins the buggy implementation.
- tests/test_phase_label_transition_and_fallback_contract.py:22-24 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The contract test only checks a subset of mutually exclusive phase labels in `phase_labels`.
  WHY: This misses regressions where new phase labels are added elsewhere but forgotten in the exclusion list, allowing stale labels to persist after transitions.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2387-2400,2491-2504,3144-3157 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The inline fallback `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` helpers do not validate the `repo` parameter before use.
  WHY: If `repo` is empty or unset, the `gh api` call fails with an unclear error instead of a direct validation failure; reviewers noted this is lower confidence because the workflow normally passes `${REPOSITORY}`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:228,2396,3154 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: PR_DATA extraction is duplicated with inconsistent variable casing and structure.
  WHY: Duplication increases divergence risk if the extraction logic changes in one place but not the others.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:198 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` uses `PUT` to replace the issue’s label set.
  WHY: If the earlier label fetch misses labels, the replacement request can delete existing non-AI labels and lose data.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:113 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: There is another `gh api` call without `gh_retry` at line 113.
  WHY: This was explicitly noted as pre-existing rather than introduced by the PR, so it is outside the main new fallback issue but still a separate finding.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:151 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The `phase_labels` list is missing `ai:needs-prompt-review` in addition to the other omitted phase labels.
  WHY: This is the same root cause as the shared label-sync bug, but the reviewer explicitly called out this label among the missing ones.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:249 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The fallback `gh api` call at line 249 lacks `gh_retry`.
  WHY: This reviewer treated it as the same retry-resilience issue, independently confirming the runtime risk.
- tests/test_phase_label_transition_and_fallback_contract.py:60 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The test assertion explicitly requires the non-`gh_retry` fallback string.
  WHY: This would block a valid fix that adds `gh_retry`, so the test must be updated with the workflow change.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:151 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `phase_labels` exclusion list omits `ai:comprehensive-test-pending`, `ai:destructive-blocked`, `ai:implement-fix-up`, and `ai:needs-prompt-review`.
  WHY: Missing these labels allows them to survive transitions and violate the “at most one AI phase label” invariant.
- tests/test_phase_label_transition_and_fallback_contract.py:22-23 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The test only asserts two labels in `phase_labels` instead of the full mutually exclusive set.
  WHY: This narrows coverage enough to miss future label-sync regressions.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:249,3144 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fallback `gh api` calls are not wrapped with `gh_retry`.
  WHY: The reviewer identified the missing retry wrapper on the fallback path as a transient-failure risk.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:138-161 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fallback path adds the target label without knowing the full current label set.
  WHY: If the GET step fails, stale mutually exclusive phase labels may remain because the fallback is add-only and does not perform a full swap.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:151 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `phase_labels` array is missing several AI phase labels that exist in the system (`ai:comprehensive-test-pending`, `ai:destructive-blocked`, `ai:implement-fix-up`).
  WHY: When `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` transitions to one of these labels, it will not remove any existing phase label from the issue because the missing labels are not in the mutual exclusion list.
- tests/test_phase_label_transition_and_fallback_contract.py:22-23 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test only verifies `"ai:needs-human"` and `"ai:blocked"` are in the `phase_labels` list, not all mutually exclusive phase labels.
  WHY: Incomplete coverage misses regressions where new phase labels are added to the catalog but not to the exclusion list.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:249 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fallback `pr_data="$(gh api ...)"` call is not wrapped with `gh_retry`.
  WHY: A transient GH API failure on this edge path can make issue-number extraction fail silently and leave linked issues in the wrong phase.
- tests/test_phase_label_transition_and_fallback_contract.py:60 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test asserts the exact non-`gh_retry` fallback command string for `pr_data`.
  WHY: If the workflow is corrected to use `gh_retry`, this assertion will fail and block CI until the test is updated.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2387-2400,2491-2504,3144-3157 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Fallback `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` functions don't validate `repo` parameter before use.
  WHY: If `repo` is empty or unset, the `gh api` call fails with an unclear error instead of a direct validation failure.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Code duplication within the same file for fallback extraction logic, with uppercase `PR_DATA` in one step and lowercase `pr_data` in another.
  WHY: Duplication increases the risk of divergence if the regex or extraction logic changes in one step.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:151 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `phase_labels` list is missing several mutually exclusive phase labels, specifically `ai:comprehensive-test-pending`, `ai:destructive-blocked`, `ai:implement-fix-up`, and `ai:needs-prompt-review`.
  WHY: The helper removes current labels by subtracting a predefined list; missing labels remain on the issue and can coexist with another phase label, violating the system invariant.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:249 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fallback extraction command `pr_data="$(gh api ...)"` does not use the `gh_retry` wrapper.
  WHY: If the fallback hits a transient GitHub API error, the workflow cannot identify linked issues and may leave them in the wrong phase.
- tests/test_phase_label_transition_and_fallback_contract.py:60 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test asserts a specific string that explicitly excludes `gh_retry` in the `pr_data` assignment.
  WHY: If the workflow is fixed to use `gh_retry`, this test will fail because it requires the old non-retry command.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:198 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` function uses a `PUT` operation to replace the entire label set on an issue.
  WHY: If the current-label fetch misses labels, the replacement request can delete existing non-AI labels and remove data.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
